label: GXP2170 IP phone
description: Grandstream GXP2170 enterprise desk phone for high-volume users, 12 lines and 4.3-inch colour LCD, with dual switched 10/100/1000 ports (LAN plus PC passthrough) and integrated 802.3af PoE. Max 5.4 W on its own, 9.2 W when four GXP2200EXT modules are cascaded off it.
notes: Datasheet: 'Dual switched auto-sensing 10/100/1000 Mbps Gigabit Ethernet ports with integrated PoE', 'Integrated Power-over-Ethernet (802.3af)', business power adapter 12 V 1 A optional. Grandstream publishes no PoE class; 5.4 W fits class 2 (6.49 W) so that is what is budgeted here - with four cascaded GXP2200EXT sidecars the same phone pulls 9.2 W and would need class 3. Built-in Bluetooth for headsets and mobile contact sync; no Wi-Fi. RJ9 headset and EHS not modelled.
